digest.component_or_area: terraform-drift CI workflow and Gerrit integration
propositions: Terraform drift workflow only triggers on pull_request, push to main, or schedule — never on Gerrit changes, so unapplied terraform lands without pre-submit validation
Post-merge terraform-drift check fails AFTER change is submitted and main goes red, but the Verified +1 gate gives no signal that infrastructure was never applied
A terraform change that passes CI and lands can have committed HCL resources that do not exist in the actual infrastructure because apply is manual and decoupled from merge
The drift check must either run pre-submit (and distinguish new additions from previously-unapplied HCL), or require explicit apply attestation in the commit message or runbook
